newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money stable at 3.03/3.08 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money stable at 3.03/3.08 pct.

text.p: German call money traded steady at 3.03/3.08 percent on Monday amid what dealers said were well balanced market conditions.
Dealers said business was relatively quiet, although some demand had been generated by a slight fall-off in banks' reserve holdings.
Bank deposits with the Bundesbank on Friday fell to 38.2 billion marks from 40.2 billion and the monthly average was down at 39.4 billion marks on Sunday from 40.2 billion.
Lombard borrowings were minimal. The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was at 3.08558 percent (3.08242).
